narr: A deep easterly flow started to bring better moisture into the region with storms developing over the Organ Mountains. Recent heavy rain over the east slopes of the Organ Mountains resulted in flash flooding and additional rain from this storm caused additional mud slides across Highway 70.
ev: Water and mud covered 2 lanes of Highway 70 at the intersection of Owen Road.
lsr: WATER AND MUD/SMALL DEBRIS COVERING 2 LANES OF HIGHWAY 70 AT THE INTERSECTION OF OWEN RD.
